title: AndroidAPS restarts on bad blob of historical data from Medtronic pump
symptom: AAPS restarts every 7-9 minutes due to historical data with incorrect date value, as seen in logs.
cause: The thread identifies that the issue is related to historical data with an incorrect date value from a Medtronic pump, but the exact root cause is not fully detailed in the thread.
fix: A fix was implemented in a branch and later merged via PR #422. The fix addresses the parsing of historical data, specifically the BolusWizardRecord problem.
evidence_quote: Fix is now done in this branch, please install and test if this fixes everything... I have run it through my history decoded and all entries seem to be correct now.
